cues.text: The Blender Foundation Presents logo appears centered on a dark, snowy, mountainous landscape with blurred, shadowy rock formations in the foreground.
Snow-covered mountains loom, with a distant, icy structure visible.
A figure in a hooded, brown outfit stands on snow, gripping a long, curved staff, with misty, snow-capped mountains looming behind them.
A figure in brown leaps through the snow.
The figure’s arm extends forward, gripping the staff.
The grey-haired man draws a knife.
The grey-haired man grips a staff as a red-haired figure bends forward, snow falling around them.
The red-haired figure lies motionless on snow, a knife resting beside them, hands clasped.
A snow-covered mountain pass holds a distant, warmly lit shelter.
The red-haired figure stands alone in the vast, snow-laden pass, gripping a staff as towering, icy peaks loom in the misty distance.
The red-haired figure looks down.
A red-haired figure stands in a sunlit.
A red-haired figure reaches out, gripping a thick, dark fabric as sunlight illuminates rustic rooftops and weathered stone buildings behind them.
The red-haired figure pulls the fabric taut.
The red-haired figure lowers their hand, revealing a tattoo on their shoulder.
The red-haired figure’s eyes open, revealing brown irises.
A small, scaly creature with orange eyes sits on a stone roof, its mouth open as a human hand extends toward it.
The red-haired figure holds the small scaly creature close, its hand gripping the creature’s tail as the creature’s mouth remains open.
A red-haired figure steps away from a crate.
A red-haired figure stands in a sunlit alleyway, facing another person.
The red-haired figure stands in a sunlit alleyway, facing forward with wide eyes and a surprised expression.
The red-haired figure bends forward.
Two large, winged creatures soar through a hazy, warm-toned sky, with a smaller red bird flying nearby.
A large winged creature dominates the foreground, its wings spread wide.
A small, winged creature clings to a larger one, both soaring through the sky.
A large winged creature soars.
A young woman with red hair and a tattoo stands before crumbling stone structures.
A blurred figure in heavy boots runs across a dusty, rocky terrain, their motion captured in a fast-moving, low-angle shot.
The sun glows brightly overhead.
A figure with red hair moves through dense bamboo.
A figure with dark hair holds a staff and raises a hand.
The red-haired figure lies buried in deep snow, a staff resting beside them, their head just visible above the white surface.
The red-haired figure stands in a snowy, jagged landscape, their fur-lined coat and staff visible as mist swirls around them.
The red-haired figure, previously buried, now looks up with a hand raised, their expression shifting as a dark, curved object enters the frame from the left.
A small figure stands on a rocky cave floor, silhouetted against a bright moonlit opening, with glowing blue crystals scattered around the cavern’s dark, textured walls.
The spiky, scaled creature lies motionless on the cavern floor, its armored back gleaming faintly under dim light as shadows deepen around it.
A gloved hand reaches toward the motionless, scaled creature.
A small figure kneels beside the creature as a fiery explosion erupts from its head.
A small, winged figure crawls across the cavern floor toward the motionless, scaled creature, its form glinting faintly in the dim light.
The red-haired woman draws a spear from the ground.
The red-haired woman leaps forward, spear drawn, as the creature's head explodes in fire, sending shards of light flying across the dark cavern floor.
The scaled creature lies motionless on the dark cavern floor, its wings and tail still.
The red-haired woman grips her spear, her face showing shock as the dark cavern floor remains still after the creature’s explosion.
The red-haired woman steps back.
The red-haired woman stands still, her gaze fixed downward.
The massive, scaled creature lies motionless in the dark cavern, its single glowing red eye fixed forward as faint sparks drift through the air.
A lone, small figure sits atop a rugged hill, dwarfed by a colossal, gnarled tree root system in the foreground, with misty, sunlit mountains receding into the hazy horizon.
The red-haired woman’s head tilts slightly as her eyes close, her expression softening.
The camera focuses on a vast, textured expanse of rough, uneven rock with deep crevices and mottled brown and grey tones.
